idea: Epic 23b row 23b.40: native SDKs fold letters above U+FFFF with u as Dart does. With u both SDKs hand these letters to the platform's engine, which folds them by its own Unicode: Linux's Foundation ICU, JDK 21, JDK 17 and Android's ICU by API level miss case pairs Dart has (Vithkuqi, Garay); and JDK 17's case-insensitive backreference never repeats a capture above U+FFFF and throws at the input's end. Fold astral letters from Dart's fold classes, as the BMP already is, and keep JDK 17's backreference off astral captures. In sdk-swift and sdk-kotlin
